note: Opening troop strengths on 5 July 1943, from the University of Oregon historian’s table based on Kurskaia bitva (1974). These figures exclude subsequent reinforcements and are not totals for all July–August operations. Soldier totals do not determine tank or aircraft quantities. Comparable casualty figures are not supplied by this source.
